prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create ONE finished flat opaque landscape poster, width:height 16:9, for a Korean neighborhood upcycling event for adults, displayed at a community cultural center and on community digital screens. Approachable for first-time residents, lively and tactile with a grown-up daytime hobby-event character. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole visual system: energetic graphic textile assemblage. Saturated cobalt blue graphic ground, warm light cream clear areas, near-black upright typography. Photographed cotton garment and two sewn pouches are substantial content-bearing cutouts in opposing corners, with coherent shallow daylight, visible cotton knit thickness, functional seams and softly controlled folds. This is a graphic poster artwork filling the entire image, not a catalogue, cover stack, framed print, wall photograph, paper collage or environmental mockup. No printed labels on the cloth.

Composition uses a 720×405 proportional planning grid, scaled to the native output. The upper-right area roughly x366–720/y0–152 holds the source T-shirt, obliquely cropped; the lower-left x0–344/y264–405 holds two finished pouches offered on separate open adult palms. Main title and activity connect across one broad uninterrupted light middle interval, roughly y128–260. Exactly TWO contiguous factual islands: attendance upper-left near x30/y16–126 and participation/preparation lower-right near x376/y271–383. Light cream areas join the middle interval like a clean broad stepped graphic field, while cobalt remains around the two textile masses; all fields are flat opaque digital color, without paper scraps, borders or fake shadows. Textile boundaries remain outside the copy regions. Keep generous edge margins, all type horizontal and aligned. Central English/title/activity share the x30 left edge with attendance; the lower-right factual island sits close to the lower edge of that middle interval. Do not scatter individual facts along seams.

Substantive visual construction: upper-right is unmistakably a worn cotton T-shirt with visible ribbed collar, sleeve junction, torso panel and lower hem, viewed obliquely from above. Cropping may trim a sleeve tip and outer surround but must preserve the collar-to-body-to-hem relation. The cream torso has exactly three broad unequal ink-dark horizontal bars in an unmistakable ordered arrangement, separated by unequal cream gaps, plus a small vermilion asymmetric reinforced patch at one hem corner. Its knit, hem and slightly worn softness look real. Lower-left are two substantial usable sewn cloth pouches, each with a clearly visible mouth/zipper opening, side seams and base; no miniature symbols. One pouch is visibly made from that chosen torso panel: SAME ordered three unequal dark bars, their unequal spacing, and SAME vermilion asymmetric reinforced corner now at the pouch base; bars truncate naturally at its new side seams. Make this correspondence clear through bounded cloth structure, beyond color alone. The second pouch is distinct plain muted vermilion/terracotta cotton, clearly a different completed pouch. Each pouch rests on its own broad open adult palm, with separate wrists entering from opposing left/bottom directions, offered toward one another to suggest sharing. Use simple legible hand support without interlaced fingers, tangled handoff, floating pouches or extra hands. Pouch fronts tilt less than the source garment so construction remains clear. The textile does not flow physically through the central title. No decorative arrows are needed.

Typography: very legible contemporary Korean sans serif, broad bold clean Korean title as first anchor, medium English lead-in directly above, semibold activity directly below, regular-to-medium horizontal factual copy. Use well-formed proportional Hangul syllable blocks, open counters and exact word spaces; no stylized glyph distortions. At the 720-pixel-wide display equivalent the title is about 44px, activity 22px, English 19px, attendance 20px with 27px pitch, participation 19px with 28px pitch. Use strong near-black-on-cream contrast. Practical information must all be readable at 720×405, not tiny footnotes. One line per entry, including title and activity. Preserve punctuation visibly: the time has a clear medium-length en dash, colons, middle dots and comma. No extra copy, logos, watermarks, QR codes, pseudo-print, numbers, style names, microtext or words on the objects. Only the eleven entries below are printed, each exactly ONCE. Group labels below are placement instructions and are NOT printed.

Upper-left attendance island, four lines:
2027.01.16 토요일
14:00–16:30
성산 생활문화센터
13:40부터 입장

Middle identity unit, top-to-bottom, with Korean title dominant:
REMAKE & SHARE
입던 옷의 다음 장면
티셔츠를 파우치로 · 완성품 나눔

Lower-right participation/preparation island, four lines:
참가비 3,000원 · 도구 제공
사전 신청 · 정원 18명
깨끗한 티셔츠 한 장 지참
바느질이 처음이어도 괜찮아요

Produce only this one complete independent poster; no comparison panels or contact sheet. Maintain the opposing-corner imagery, central linking title and two diagonal factual islands as one coherent composition. Finish cloth cutout edges, hand/object contacts, light consistency and clean type edges carefully.
